timing.method: backend events around batches; elapsed / actual launch count; no cache flush
timing.includes: kernel work, device scheduling and amortized event overhead; events mode additionally includes host dispatch gaps
timing.excludes: JIT compilation, allocation, initialization, validation, capture and warmup
